profile_text.body:
UiPath is a publicly traded enterprise software company (NYSE: PATH, CIK 0001734722) that describes itself as offering the UiPath Platform for business orchestration and automation. The platform is positioned around enabling AI agents, robots, and people to work together to deliver what the company describes as secure, compliant outcomes at scale. Its capabilities span robotic process automation, document understanding, process mining, and enterprise automation governance.

The company's primary tracked product, UiPath AI, combines RPA with AI and is aimed at large organizations across sectors including insurance, government, financial services, and advertising. The company's own site cites several customer outcomes: Johnson Controls saving $18 million and 900,000 hours by automating invoice processing, Uber on pace to save $22 million through automation, VITAL serving 450% more agencies while saving 15,000 work hours, and dentsu saving more than 125,000 hours. TQL is also cited as a customer managing 33,000 decisions a day using the platform.

No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for UiPath.
